lines.text: Each Corinthian is to set aside a portion of his income on the first day of every week, and recommended men will carry the gift to Antioch.
Paul will come to Corinth after going through Macedonia, and he hopes to spend some time there if the Lord permits.
Paul will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost because a great door for effective work has opened to him.
Paul asks that Timothy have nothing to fear in Corinth, and he strongly urged Apollos to go to Corinth with the brothers.
Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus tested Paul's spirit.
